cohort: 202 patients with simple VVF undergoing transvaginal repair at a tertiary care hospital from 1999 to 2019, compared to a literature reported cohort of 260 patients undergoing VVF repair by minimally invasive techniques
finding: Transvaginal VVF repair is comparable to minimally invasive approaches in terms of post-operative outcomes and morbidity, but offers advantages in terms of cost and resource utilization.
